2608.13244.title: Localize, Then Reason: Visual Latent Structural Reasoning for Molecular Properties and Edits
2608.13244.paper_summary: Local chemical perception and property reasoning are both essential for understanding how molecular structure determines properties. Current LLM-based chemical reasoning methods either receive SMILES/molecular images together with descriptions of local motifs, or reason directly from molecular images. Neither approach enables the model to focus on chemically meaningful regions before reasoning. To address this gap, we propose Visual Latent Structural Reasoning (VLSR), an end-to-end framework that jointly learns localization and reasoning from molecular images. Central to our approach is a localize-then-reason strategy. VLSR first learns to locate chemically meaningful regions in a molecular image. It then reasons about their property effects in a compact latent workspace before producing the final answer. Under the same inference setup, this design achieves 9.6X higher throughput than a comparable textual-reasoning baseline.
2608.13244.paper_summary_zh: 地方化學感知和性質推理對於理解分子結構如何決定性質都是至關重要的。當前基於LLM的化學推理方法要麼接收SMILES/分子圖像及其地方特徵的描述，要麼直接從分子圖像進行推理。這兩種方法都無法使模型在推理之前專注於具有化學意義的區域。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了視覺潛在結構推理（VLSR），這是一個端到端的框架，能夠從分子圖像中共同學習定位和推理。我們方法的核心是一種先定位後推理的策略。VLSR首先學會在分子圖像中定位具有化學意義的區域。然後，它在一個緊湊的潛在工作空間中推理這些區域的性質影響，然後產生最終答案。在相同的推理設置下，這一設計的吞吐量比可比較的文本推理基準高出9.6倍。
